results.operating_point: builtin-heuristic native verdict (analyze_text); no score threshold; no threshold was fitted, no calibration was fitted — the operating point is fixed by the detector

partition.method: group = near-duplicate group (exact content hash, merged at word-8-shingle Jaccard >= 0.8); bucket = int(sha256(group), 16) % 10; buckets 0-2 fit, 3-4 dev/selection, 5-9 final-test. No near-duplicate of a final-test row appears in fit/dev. Assignment uses row identity only, never a detector score. Fit/dev were never scored and no decision was fitted on them.

provenance.dataset_version: TheItCrOw/GhostWriter snapshot 2026-11-16 (no versioned release); pooled from the U1 500-row strided sample (2026-11-07) and a new phase-shifted 2000-row strided sample (2026-11-16, +83 offset shift)
provenance.label_provenance: label 0 human / 1 AI / 2 fusion; only fulltext rows carry binary labels (label 2 rows are chunks and carry no binary label — the U4 spine, not U1 evidence)
provenance.normalization_provenance: rows mapped by textforensics.datasets.map_row('ghostwriter') at fetch time; cached normalised JSONL verified by SHA-256
provenance.sampling: strided (both pooled samples); new sample offsets i*332224//2000+83, disjoint from the U1 offsets by row index and by content hash

threshold_sensitivity.note: Sensitivity analysis only. The native ai_like threshold 0.68 is UNCHANGED: these rows report what the human FPR would be at perturbed thresholds; they do not propose moving the threshold.

threshold_sensitivity_detail.interpretation: The final-test top human score 0.674 comes from cache file train.jsonl (the U1 sample). If it is the U1 row, the -0.02 fragility (one row flips at 0.66) is NOT independent confirmation on fresh data — it is that one known row. On fresh (train-2000) human rows alone the maximum is 0.6496 and zero-FPR DOES survive a -0.02 perturbation (k=0 at 0.66). Both facts are reported; the threshold is UNCHANGED either way.

results.threshold_sensitivity_note: Zero-FPR at the native 0.68 threshold does NOT survive a -0.02 perturbation on the full final-test slice (one row flips at 0.66; FPR 1/354) — but that one row is the known U1 row (see threshold_sensitivity_detail), so the fragility is not independent confirmation on fresh data: on fresh train-2000 human rows alone the maximum is 0.6496 and zero-FPR survives -0.02. The threshold is UNCHANGED; this is reported, not acted on.
